ja: 直したコードはずっと読みやすいね。
en: It's much easier to read now.
alternatives: This is much easier to read now.
It's much more readable now.
point: 比較級を強めるのは very ではなく much

ja: マージ前に DB チームが確認すべきだったのでは？
en: Shouldn't the DB team have reviewed this before merging?
alternatives: Shouldn't this have been reviewed by the DB team first?
Shouldn't the database team have checked this before it merged?
point: 「すべきだったのでは」は Shouldn't + have + 過去分詞

ja: レビュー頼む前に、テスト全部通してたよ。
en: I'd gotten every test passing before I asked.
alternatives: Before asking, I'd made every test pass.
I'd gotten all the tests passing before I asked.
point: 頼む前に済んでいたことは had + 過去分詞で表す

ja: この関数、分割を検討してもらえますか？
en: Could you consider splitting this function?
alternatives: Would you consider splitting this function up?
Could you think about splitting this function?
point: consider の後ろは to 不定詞ではなく動名詞

ja: マージ前に再テストをお願いします。
en: Please retest before you merge.
alternatives: Please run the tests again before merging.
Test it again before you merge, please.
point: before の後ろは未来のことでも現在形

ja: 指摘された点は、もう全部直しました。
en: I've already fixed everything you pointed out.
alternatives: I've fixed everything you pointed out already.
I've already addressed all your comments.
point: 「もう直した」は現在完了 I've already fixed

ja: ここ、誤字が一つあるよ。
en: There is a typo here.
alternatives: I see a typo here.
There's a typo on this line.
point: 一つなので There is、a typo と単数形に

ja: レビューは明日までに終わらせます。
en: I'll finish the review by tomorrow.
alternatives: I'll get the review done by tomorrow.
I'll finish reviewing it by tomorrow.
point: 期限の「までに」は until ではなく by

ja: リベースしてから、テストが3件ずっと落ちてる。
en: Three tests have been failing since I rebased.
alternatives: Since I rebased, three tests have been failing.
Three tests have been failing ever since I rebased.
point: since の後ろは過去形、続いている状態は現在完了進行形

ja: ここに情報を少し足してもらえますか？
en: Could you add some information here?
alternatives: Can you add a little information here?
Could you add some more details here?
point: information は数えられないので an も -s もつけない

ja: 見てほしいのは、ネット切断時にリトライが動くかです。
en: What I'd like you to check is whether retries work offline.
alternatives: Could you check whether retries work offline?
What I want you to check is if retries work offline.
point: 「見てほしいのは」は What I'd like you to check is で始める

ja: この変数を分かりやすく改名しました。
en: I renamed the variable to clarify it.
alternatives: I renamed this variable for clarity.
I renamed this variable to be clearer.
point: 「〜するために」は to ＋動詞の原形

ja: リトライがエラーを隠さないか心配でした。
en: I was worried the retries would hide errors.
alternatives: I was afraid the retries would mask errors.
I was worried retries might hide errors.
point: 「心配だった」は I was worried + 節で続ける

ja: このテスト、なぜ削除したんですか？
en: Why did you delete this test?
alternatives: Why did you remove this test?
How come you deleted this test?
point: 過去のことを聞くので did ＋動詞の原形

ja: あの時テストしてれば、僕ら今デバッグしてないのに。
en: If we'd tested then, we wouldn't be debugging now.
alternatives: If we'd tested back then, we wouldn't be debugging now.
We wouldn't be debugging now if we'd tested then.
point: 過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞、今の結果は wouldn't be -ing

ja: 細かいですが、変数名をもっと明確にできるかも。
en: Nitpick, but this variable name could be clearer.
alternatives: Small thing, but this name could be clearer.
It's minor, but this name could be a bit clearer.
point: 「かもしれません」は could で柔らかく言う

ja: リードが、この変数名わかりにくいって。
en: The lead said this name was confusing.
alternatives: The lead told me this name was confusing.
The lead said this name was unclear.
point: said に合わせて is ではなく was にする

ja: ごめん、エラー再現できなかった。
en: Sorry, I couldn't reproduce the error.
alternatives: Sorry, I wasn't able to reproduce it.
Sorry, I couldn't reproduce that error.
point: 過去の「できなかった」は couldn't

ja: この関数、長すぎますか？
en: Is this function too long?
alternatives: Is the function too long?
Is this function too big?
point: 形容詞の疑問文は be 動詞を文頭に出す

ja: このバグ、先週入り込んだんだね。
en: This bug was introduced last week.
alternatives: The bug got introduced last week.
This bug came in last week.
point: 「入り込んだ」は誰かが入れたと見て、was introduced と受動態にする

ja: 変数名ごときで、話を長引かせるのはやめよう。
en: Let's not drag this out over a variable name.
alternatives: Let's not waste more time arguing over a variable name.
We shouldn't draw this out over a variable name.
point: 「長引かせる」は drag out（drag this out）

ja: 見つけてくれなかったら、僕らそのまま出してた。
en: If you hadn't caught it, we'd have shipped it.
alternatives: If you hadn't spotted it, we'd have released it.
We'd have shipped it if you hadn't caught it.
point: 過去の事実に反する仮定は had + 過去分詞、帰結は would have

ja: 田中さんにレビュー頼んでくれる？
en: Can you ask Tanaka to review it?
alternatives: Can you ask Tanaka for a review?
Can you get Tanaka to review it?
point: 「人に〜するよう頼む」は ask + 人 + to do

ja: マージしたら、僕からチームに知らせます。
en: I'll tell the team when I merge.
alternatives: I'll let the team know once I merge.
Once I merge, I'll tell the team.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形で merge とする

ja: きっと君、スナップショットの更新を忘れたんですね。
en: You must have forgotten to update the snapshots.
alternatives: Looks like you forgot to update the snapshots.
I bet you forgot to update the snapshots.
point: 過去への確信ある推量は must have + 過去分詞

ja: 正直、この抽象化はやりすぎかもしれません。
en: Honestly, this abstraction might be overkill.
alternatives: To be honest, this abstraction may be a bit much.
Frankly, I think this abstraction is overkill.
point: 「かもしれません」は might で断定をやわらげる
